name: Moly Elixir
body:
Aura strong abjuration; CL 18th; Slot none; Price 7,200 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

Moly is a magical herb with black roots and white flowers, and no mortal has the strength to pull it from the ground. But from time to time the gods pluck moly from the ground and give it to mortals, and it can be used to make a potent elixir. When drank or rubbed on a creature’s skin, it provides a +8 resistance bonus to saves against spells and spell-like abilities for three hours. It can also be split into three doses, each lasting an hour.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, protection from spells; Cost 3,600 gp.

or

Craft (alchemy), moly herb; DC 28; Cost 0 gp.
